title: Jaggery Radio with Nishévitha
body: Nishévitha pours her love into this episode of Jaggery Radio on Jerome FM. With a singular, ambient mix Nishevitha attempts to transcend time and different expressions of feeling throughout generations of RnB, Soul, and Jazz music. She features cuts like "I Loves You, Porgy" by Nina Simone, an indian classical Veena rendition of raagam Desh, and finishes off the mix with Warda's notorious "Al Basata". She hopes listeners indulge in beauty this month.
